tasks.short: Evaluate finance staff, discuss performance, and recommend or implement personnel actions.

steps.what: Gather objectives, delivery records and previous feedback.
Assess contribution and write the performance review.
Discuss performance, hear context and agree development actions.
Recommend promotion, support measures or dismissal where warranted.
Review employment requirements and authorise the personnel action.
Record the approved personnel action in the {HCM}.

tasks.design: A restricted dashboard joins objectives from the {TALENT} with relevant delivery records from the {ERP} and evidence links from the {DOCS}. The manager writes the assessment and conducts the conversation; configured approvals in the {HCM} route personnel actions and record approved changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence sits across systems, and delivery measures need context. Existing review forms rarely remove the effort of finding supporting records.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding can shorten construction of restricted connectors, evidence views and review templates. Existing approval configuration handles the records work.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing contribution fairly, hearing disputed evidence and following national employment rules remain demanding. GDPR access controls and any required employee consultation need attention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising invisible work, understanding team context and delivering difficult feedback with care.
tasks.altitude: Less review preparation leaves more time for coaching and checking whether support helped. Existing personnel approval rights remain with the designated approvers.

reach.task: Build a contextual finance delivery dashboard.
reach.learn: Metric definitions, access controls and why throughput alone cannot measure individual contribution.

evidence.claim: Evidence assembly and approved record updates can use deterministic technology; contextual personnel judgement remains human.
The digest provides no directly matching implementation case or measured saving for this design.

assumptions: The baseline represents periodic reviews in a mid-size company, rather than continuous employee monitoring.
The design collects existing evidence and does not generate employee scores or personnel recommendations.
Build ranges estimate working effort, including applicable consultation preparation; statutory waiting periods may extend elapsed time.
unknowns: Which roles may access individual delivery records and feedback?
Who has delegated authority for each personnel action?
Which national rules and employee consultation requirements apply?
Can the existing systems expose appropriately restricted records?
research_questions: Which evidence helps managers distinguish delivery problems from workload or process problems?
Can existing review configuration provide the evidence view without a custom dashboard?
new_work: Correct incomplete or misleading evidence before review discussions.
Maintain access permissions and evidence definitions.
Check that managers do not treat operational measures as automatic performance ratings.

tasks.short: Prepare annual tax information, resolve tax treatments and arrange approved filing.

steps.what: Export the trial balance, ledger detail and fixed-asset records.
Reconcile balances and map ledger accounts into tax schedules.
Read supporting documents and assemble referenced supporting schedules.

loop.input: Supporting documents requiring dates, amounts, parties and references for specified schedule fields.
loop.output: Proposed schedule fields with document and page references, plus missing evidence flags.
loop.check: Validate field types and arithmetic; compare amounts with ledger records; require a source reference for each extracted fact.
loop.stop: At most two extraction passes per document within a fixed batch budget; unresolved fields go to the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use structured fields and fixed templates first. Varied contracts and narrative supporting documents need bounded text extraction.

steps.what: Resolve exceptions and determine material tax treatments.
Prepare the return in {OTHER} tax preparation software.
Review liabilities, disclosures and material positions; authorise filing.
Submit the authorised return through the {GOV_PORTAL} and retain its receipt.

tasks.design: Configured exports from the {ERP} feed deterministic reconciliation and tax schedules, with supporting evidence retained in the {DOCS}. A bounded extraction loop proposes referenced document fields, while the tax accountant determines treatments and configured {OTHER} tax preparation software generates the return. The authorised filer submits through the {GOV_PORTAL} after approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Account mappings, supporting evidence and tax adjustments are maintained separately. Tax preparation software often already calculates the return, leaving substantial work around it.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding reduces the effort of building mapping checks, reconciliation schedules and evidence links. Bounded extraction can assist with varied documents without deciding tax positions.
tasks.still_hard: Material tax treatments, incomplete evidence and changing national filing requirements need specialist attention. Access to outside accountants' systems can limit integration.
tasks.human_edge: Defending tax positions, assessing uncertainty and deciding when specialist advice is warranted.
tasks.altitude: The controller spends less time assembling annual evidence and more time resolving tax exposure before year-end. Tax positions and filing authority stay with the designated specialists and signatories.

reach.task: Maintain a quarterly schedule of unresolved tax positions.
reach.learn: Tax adjustment categories, evidence standards and escalation thresholds.

evidence.claim: Ledger mapping, arithmetic reconciliation and return population can use deterministic rules and configured tax software.
Document extraction can propose referenced fields, but this digest supplies no matching tax implementation case or measured saving.

assumptions: The baseline covers corporate annual tax preparation; return types and national requirements differ.
A qualified internal or external tax accountant remains responsible for tax treatments.
The chosen tax preparation software supports schedule imports or configured population.
Build ranges are working-effort estimates for one entity and one filing regime.
unknowns: Which entities, jurisdictions and return types are in scope?
Does the company prepare returns internally or supply information to outside accountants?
Which imports, exports and filing routes are supported?
Who may access supporting documents and authorise filing?
research_questions: Which recurring reconciliation exceptions account for most preparation effort?
Can structured evidence replace document extraction for the largest supporting schedules?
Which existing tax software features can eliminate manual schedule population?
new_work: Maintain account mappings and versioned tax schedules.
Review extracted fields and obtain missing evidence.
Handle rejected imports or filings and retain submission receipts.
Revalidate rules and document templates when filing requirements change.

tasks.short: Coordinate finance staff, prioritise work and resolve delivery or control problems.

steps.what: Inspect finance queues, deadlines and reported blockers.
Set priorities and assign work against deadlines and available capacity.
Discuss blockers, explain priorities and coach staff.
Resolve escalated accounting, collection, payroll or control exceptions.
Request progress updates and record action completion.

tasks.design: A restricted {BI} view combines queue status from the {ERP}, milestone status from the {PAYROLL} and actions from the {PROJECT}. Configured reminders and completion signals replace routine chasing in the {EMAIL} and {CHAT}. The manager assigns work, coaches people and approves substantive exception decisions within existing limits.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finance processes expose status in different systems, while deadlines and blockers are often tracked separately. Routine chasing persists because completion signals are not connected.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes small status connectors and exception views cheaper to build. Existing task configuration can handle reminders, ownership and escalation timing.
tasks.still_hard: Queue counts do not capture complexity or hidden workload. Sensitive payroll information requires restricted views, and control exceptions still need accountable judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Balancing urgent deadlines with sustainable workloads, developing staff and challenging weak explanations.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time requesting status and more time removing recurring blockers and building cover for critical duties. Work allocation remains within existing management authority; financial approval limits stay in force.

reach.task: Forecast finance workload during close and budget peaks.
reach.learn: Capacity scenarios, task complexity estimates and uncertainty ranges.

evidence.claim: Status aggregation, reminders and action tracking can use deterministic integration and existing workflow configuration.
The digest offers no directly matching supervisory implementation case; coaching and exception decisions remain judgement-heavy.

assumptions: Source systems record usable task status or completion milestones.
The dashboard supports process coordination rather than individual performance scoring.
Payroll access exposes only the status needed for supervision.
Build ranges include access design and applicable national employee consultation work.
unknowns: Which finance processes already have reliable queues and completion records?
Where are deadlines and blockers currently maintained?
Which employee-data uses require consultation under applicable national rules?
Which decisions exceed the finance manager's delegated authority?
research_questions: Which missing status signals generate the most manual chasing?
Can the existing {PROJECT} configuration handle reminders and action tracking?
What workload measures reflect complexity without becoming employee ratings?
new_work: Maintain queue definitions, deadline calendars and escalation routes.
Resolve stale or contradictory source statuses.
Adjust reminders to prevent unnecessary notifications.
Review whether capacity estimates reflect actual task complexity.

tasks.short: Calculate payroll deductions, review exceptions, finalise withholding and account for deduction liabilities.

steps.what: Retrieve approved deduction changes and employee master-data updates.
Enter deduction changes and effective dates in the {PAYROLL}.
Run the draft payroll calculation using configured deduction rules.
Reconcile deduction totals and compare employee changes with the previous period.
Investigate exceptions and approve necessary deduction corrections.
Approve final deduction totals and finalise withholding in the {PAYROLL}.
Post deduction liabilities and reconcile the payroll journal in the {ERP}.

tasks.design: Configure the {HCM} and {PAYROLL} to transfer approved deduction changes, enforce effective dates and calculate draft deductions. Native reconciliation rules produce exceptions for review, and the payroll manager approves final withholding. A configured interface posts approved liabilities to the {ERP} and checks journal totals without a model loop.
tasks.previous_blocker: Calculation is usually already automated. Manual effort remains in change entry, comparisons, exception investigation and journal transfer because configuration or interfaces are incomplete.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing payroll configuration covers the core arithmetic. AI coding can accelerate any missing validation or interface work, without replacing maintained national payroll rules.
tasks.still_hard: Retroactive corrections, ambiguous deduction instructions and national rule changes need payroll expertise. Some companies already automate most of this workflow, leaving limited additional savings.
tasks.human_edge: Resolving unusual deductions and protecting employees from incorrect withholding.
tasks.altitude: The controller reviews exceptions and liability controls rather than overseeing repeated data entry. Payroll approval and payment decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Reconcile payroll deduction liabilities through settlement.
reach.learn: Liability account mapping, period cut-offs and reconciliation of subsequent payments.

evidence.claim: Configured payroll software generally calculates statutory and contractual deductions; the opportunity often lies in surrounding manual controls.
The digest recommends configuration for payroll deductions but supplies no directly matching product case or measured saving.

assumptions: The {PAYROLL} supports the applicable national deduction rules and effective dates.
Deduction changes already receive valid authorisation before entering this workflow.
Native reconciliation and journal interfaces are tried before custom development.
Build ranges include payroll comparison runs, access controls and applicable national consultation work.
unknowns: Which deduction changes are still entered manually?
Which reconciliation and journal features are already configured?
How are retroactive changes and exceptional deductions authorised?
What national rules, access restrictions and employee consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Which manual checks duplicate validated controls already available in the {PAYROLL}?
Can effective-date and account-mapping errors be caught before the payroll cut-off?
Which exceptions genuinely require interpretation rather than corrected source data?
new_work: Maintain deduction mappings, effective-date checks and approval permissions.
Investigate rejected changes and reconciliation exceptions.
Validate configuration updates against representative payroll cases.
Monitor journal transfers and prevent duplicate posting.

role.altitude: The treasurer or controller spends less time assembling evidence, chasing status and supervising data transfers. More of the week goes to coaching, tax exposure, finance capacity and control exceptions; formal personnel, filing and payroll authorities remain explicit.
reach: Business intelligence analysts: define useful finance status measures and restricted evidence views.
Tax preparers: maintain earlier visibility of unresolved tax positions.
Budget analysts: forecast finance workload and cross-training needs.
Accountants: extend deduction controls from payroll calculation to liability settlement.
skills_to_grow: Configure existing systems before commissioning custom tools.
Define reusable records, mappings and reconciliation rules.
Design access controls and approvals around specific actions.
Review source-linked extraction without delegating tax judgement.
Interpret operational measures in their workload and people context.
Measure time saved after including exception handling and maintenance.
role.ambitious_version: Run a finance function that identifies tax evidence gaps, capacity constraints and payroll control failures earlier, while keeping consequential decisions with accountable people.
